Bottom line: no hook exists today that can show a filled Vent result card without the network. One small app-side hook is needed (section 2), plus a Release build for an honest free-tier view (section 3).

1. What exists
- `-uitest` (AppLaunchEnvironment.swift:18). Skips onboarding, the age gate and the content notice (RoastMateApp.swift:91-96). It also resets cloudConsent and echoesFeralConsent to .notAsked on every launch (RoastMateApp.swift:106-107), so the first Vent Generate always shows CloudConsentSheet. A test can rely on that and tap Allow.
- `-uitestLang`: works. Verified for zh-Hant, en and ja.
- `-uitestRoommateFixture <base64>` (AppLaunchEnvironment.swift:39-54). Consumed only by the roommate scene (EchoesEngine.swift:207); it does nothing for the generator.
- Scenarios.json: localized prompts in all 4 locales. The new test uses these to fill the situation.
- SampleRoasts.json vent demos: sample_16_vent has a zh-Hans response and sample_17_vent an English one. History seeds them as ventDraft + sendableReply sessions (HistoryService.swift:189-224). That covers only 2 languages, and the situation is seeded in the response locale (HistoryService.swift:137), so it cannot give a zh-Hant or ja Vent card.

2. What is missing
There is no deterministic Vent OUTPUT on the generator. Vent goes RoastGeneratorViewModel.generate → CloudPermission (needs consent) → RoastEngine.generateDetailed cloud branch (RoastEngine.swift:158-179) → runCloudVent, which calls the live Worker.

Minimal hook, about 15 lines of app code (not done: outside my allowed files and not the root cause):
- (i) `AppLaunchEnvironment.uiTestVentFixture`, reading `-uitestVentFixture <base64>` with the same decode as the roommate fixture.

  - Private drafts always return exactly 1 variant (RoastEngine.swift:146), so the Debug/Pro variantCount=3 does not inflate the card.
- (iii) Fixture texts: real Worker outputs for the boss_credit prompt in each locale. Generate them once (wrangler dev --remote or the live app), hand-pick them like the roommate judge-panel winner, and store them at e.g. marketing/appstore/vent-fixtures/{en,zh-Hant,ja,zh-Hans}.txt. The script passes `TEST_RUNNER_VENT_FIXTURE=$(base64 < file)` per locale.
- (iv) Test flow for scene `01-vent-result`:
  - Tap the scenario, then select Vent (already implemented).
  - Tap Generate. Labels: Generate / 开始生成 / 開始生成 / 生成する.
  - Tap Allow. Labels ('cloud.consent.allow'): Allow Cloud AI / 允许使用云端 AI / 允許使用雲端 AI / クラウドAIを許可.
  - Wait for the vent card ('output.rewrite.button' or the vent-draft kind label).

code.paywall_feature_facts:
How Pro is determined: StoreService.isPro (Shared/Services/StoreService.swift:52-58) is hard-coded true in DEBUG. In Release it is true only with a verified current entitlement to the monthly or yearly product (:154-180, DEBUG short-circuit at :155-163).

What Pro actually unlocks (all code-true):
1. Feral intensity. Intensity.swift:47 requiresPro=true. Gated in RoastGeneratorViewModel.swift:98 and FeatureGenerator.swift:118, locked in the UI at RoastGeneratorView.swift:286-288 and :342-346. Feral is cloud-routed through the Worker and needs the 5.1.2(i) consent. The gate is client-side only: the Worker's /v1/vent checks that the intensity is legal (index.js:542-547) but never checks Pro.
2. Savage intensity. Intensity.swift:47. Savage is a sendable mode, so it runs on-device only. On a phone without Apple's on-device model it returns curated examples, which PaywallView.swift:215-227 discloses with the paywall.feature.savage.detail.curated row.
3. The 16 Pro styles. 24 total in Shared/Resources/StylePresets.json, 8 free and 16 Pro, gated at RoastGeneratorViewModel.swift:94 and FeatureGenerator.swift:114.
4. Argument simulator. FeatureGenerator.swift:539 proGated:true. ArgumentSimulatorView.swift:30-35 opens the paywall on appear for free users, and :106-108 disables Start when !isPro. Its turns resolve as the .sharp intensity (ArgumentSimulatorViewModel.swift:141), so it is on-device or curated, never cloud.
5. Unlimited history. Free users are pruned to 30 sessions that are not favorited and not sample data (HistoryService.swift:61-63, :95-111). Pro is never pruned.
6. Unlimited generations. Pro never spends a credit (RoastGeneratorViewModel.swift:129, :179). The Worker still caps the Pro cloud lane at 200 per account per day (wrangler.toml:89, lane.js:38) and 200 per app IP (wrangler.toml:100).
7. Three variants per sendable generation instead of one: variantCount isPro ? 3 : 1 (RoastGeneratorViewModel.swift:157, FeatureGenerator.swift:169). Private drafts (Vent and Feral) are always 1 (RoastEngine.swift:146). This is a real benefit that no header currently names.
8. Echoes and the roommate group are Pro-gated (FeatureGenerator.swift:566, :577) but only visible in zh-Hans (ExploreView.swift:64, :77). Keep them off the paywall.

Free in code: Calm, Sharp and Vent (Intensity.swift:46); the 8 free styles; Reply Helper, Emotion Translator and Social Roast (FeatureGenerator.swift:517, :528, :550, all proGated:false).

The free generation limit is a credit wallet, not a daily cap:
- 10 seeded trial credits (CreditCatalog.swift:29).
- A 7-day starter window (:34) with 2 free generations a day (:38).
- After that, purchased credits only (UserSettings.swift:386-390 canSpendNow, :413-444 spendOneCredit).
- A credit is charged only when a model actually wrote the output (provenance == .model, RoastGeneratorViewModel.swift:179), so curated output is free and unmetered.
- The free cloud lane is also capped at 30 per device per day (wrangler.toml:84).
- The '5/day + first 20' quota (UserSettings.swift:237-299) is marked LEGACY and is not on the live path.

Honesty note for the new header: on a device without the on-device model, items 2-4 deliver curated examples only. Pro is always true in DEBUG, so the header must be checked in a Release build.

6. PATCH /v1/appAssetLibraryImages/{id} {data:{type, id, attributes:{uploaded:true}}}. No checksum in this model.

11. Read back with GET /v1/appStoreVersionLocalizations/{loc}/placements?sort=placementGroupPosition&include=image and count per locale.

PATH B (deprecated set model, as the plan wrote it; still answers GET):
1. POST /v1/appScreenshotSets {data:{type:'appScreenshotSets', attributes:{screenshotDisplayType:'APP_IPHONE_67'}, relationships:{appStoreVersionLocalization:{data:{type:'appStoreVersionLocalizations', id:loc}}}}}.
2. POST /v1/appScreenshots {data:{type:'appScreenshots', attributes:{fileName, fileSize}, relationships:{appScreenshotSet:{data:{type:'appScreenshotSets', id:set}}}}}. The response returns uploadOperations and assetDeliveryState AWAITING_UPLOAD.

6. Set the order with PATCH /v1/appScreenshotSets/{set}/relationships/appScreenshots {data:[{type:'appScreenshots', id}...]}.
